require 'fastimage'
require 'deliver/app_screenshot'
require_relative 'module'
require_relative 'offsets'
require_relative 'strings_parser'

module Frameit
  class Device
    REQUIRED_PRIORITY = 999

    attr_reader :id
    attr_reader :deliver_screen_id
    attr_reader :formatted_name
    attr_reader :resolutions
    attr_reader :density_ppi
    attr_reader :default_color
    attr_reader :platform
    attr_reader :priority_config_key

    def initialize(id, formatted_name, priority, resolutions, density_ppi, default_color, platform = Platform::IOS, deliver_screen_id = nil, priority_config_key = nil)
      Raise("Priority mustn't be higher than #{REQUIRED_PRIORITY}") if priority > REQUIRED_PRIORITY
      @id = id
      @deliver_screen_id = deliver_screen_id
      @formatted_name = formatted_name
      @priority = priority
      @resolutions = resolutions
      @density_ppi = density_ppi
      @default_color = default_color
      @platform = platform
      @priority_config_key = priority_config_key
    end

    def priority
      return @priority if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      if !@priority_config_key.nil? && Frameit.config[@priority_config_key]
        REQUIRED_PRIORITY
      else
        @priority
      end
    end

    def is_chosen_platform?(platform)
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return true if platform == Platform::ANY
      return true if @platform == platform
      return true if android_device? && platform == Platform::ANDROID
      return true if ios_device? && platform == Platform::IOS
      false
    end

    def formatted_name_without_apple
      return "" if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip.to_s
    end

    def preferred_over?(other)
      return false if other.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      comparable_priority_value > other.priority
    end

    def android_device?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @platform == Platform::ANDROID
    end

    def ios_device?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @platform == Platform::IOS
    end

    def referenced_in_filename?(filename)
      return false if filename.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      vendorless = @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip
      token_hit = filename_match_tokens.any? { |token| !token.nil? && !token.to_s.empty? && filename.include?(token) }
      [
        contains_vendorless_name_in_filename?(filename),
        contains_raw_id_in_filename?(filename),
        contains_full_name_in_filename?(filename),
        token_hit,
        !vendorless.empty? && filename.include?(vendorless),
        !@id.to_s.empty? && filename.include?(@id),
        family_token_in_filename?(filename),
        identity_bundle_matches_filename?(filename)
      ].any?
    end

    def contains_vendorless_name_in_filename?(filename)
      return false if filename.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      name = vendorless_formatted_name
      return false if name.empty?
      return true if filename.include?(name)
      stripped = filename.to_s.strip
      return true if stripped.include?(name)
      false
    end

    def contains_raw_id_in_filename?(filename)
      return false if filename.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      identifier = compact_identifier
      return false if identifier.empty?
      return true if filename.include?(identifier)
      return true if filename.include?(@id)
      false
    end

    def contains_full_name_in_filename?(filename)
      return false if filename.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return false if @formatted_name.to_s.empty?
      return true if filename.include?(@formatted_name)
      return true if filename.to_s.include?(@formatted_name.to_s)
      false
    end

    def matches_lookup_token?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      vendorless = @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip
      [
        id_equals_token?(token),
        deliver_screen_equals_token?(token),
        vendorless_name_equals_token?(token),
        lookup_token_candidates.include?(token),
        vendorless == token,
        @id == token,
        lookup_token_matches_family?(token),
        identity_bundle_matches_token?(token)
      ].any?
    end

    def id_equals_token?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @id == token
    end

    def deliver_screen_equals_token?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @deliver_screen_id.nil?
      @deliver_screen_id == token
    end

    def vendorless_name_equals_token?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip == token
    end

    def lookup_token_candidates
      candidates = []
      candidates << @id unless @id.nil?
      candidates << @deliver_screen_id unless @deliver_screen_id.nil?
      candidates << @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip unless @formatted_name.nil?
      candidates
    end

    def vendorless_formatted_name
      return "" if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return @formatted_name.strip.to_s unless apple_branded?
      @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip.to_s
    end

    def apple_branded?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @formatted_name.include?("Apple")
    end

    def filename_match_tokens
      tokens = []
      tokens << @id unless @id.nil? || @id.to_s.empty?
      name = vendorless_formatted_name
      tokens << name unless name.empty?
      tokens << @formatted_name unless @formatted_name.nil? || @formatted_name.to_s.empty?
      tokens.uniq
    end

    def compact_identifier
      return "" if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @id.to_s
    end

    def deliver_screen_token
      return nil if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      @deliver_screen_id
    end

    def triple_density?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      !@density_ppi.nil? && @density_ppi > 400
    end

    def mini?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      !@density_ppi.nil? && @density_ppi < 300
    end

    def high_density?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      !@density_ppi.nil? && @density_ppi >= 300
    end

    def density_bucket
      return :unknown if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @density_ppi.nil?
      return :mini if mini?
      return :retina if high_density? && !triple_density?
      return :super_retina if triple_density?
      :retina
    end

    def padding_density_multiplier
      return 1.0 if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return 1.7 if density_bucket == :super_retina
      1.0
    end

    def default_frame_available?
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      !@default_color.nil?
    end

    def iphone_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("iphone")
    end

    def ipad_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("ipad")
    end

    def pixel_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("pixel")
    end

    def samsung_identity?
      haystack = "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase
      haystack.include?("samsung") || haystack.include?("galaxy")
    end

    def nexus_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("nexus")
    end

    def htc_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("htc")
    end

    def huawei_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("huawei")
    end

    def motorola_identity?
      haystack = "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase
      haystack.include?("motorola") || haystack.include?("moto")
    end

    def mac_identity?
      haystack = "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase
      haystack.include?("macbook") || haystack.split.include?("mac")
    end

    def watch_identity?
      "#{@id} #{@formatted_name}".downcase.include?("watch")
    end

    def android_family_identity?
      [pixel_identity?, samsung_identity?, nexus_identity?, htc_identity?, huawei_identity?, motorola_identity?, android_device?].any?
    end

    def apple_family_identity?
      [iphone_identity?, ipad_identity?, mac_identity?, watch_identity?, apple_branded?].any?
    end

    def family_token_in_filename?(filename)
      return false if filename.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      haystack = filename.to_s
      vendorless = @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip
      family_match = [iphone_identity?, ipad_identity?, pixel_identity?, samsung_identity?, nexus_identity?, htc_identity?, huawei_identity?, motorola_identity?, mac_identity?].any?
      family_match && (haystack.include?(@id) || haystack.include?(vendorless))
    end

    def lookup_token_matches_family?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return true if @id == token
      return true if @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip == token
      return true if @deliver_screen_id == token unless @deliver_screen_id.nil?
      false
    end

    def identity_bundle
      return {} if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      vendorless = @formatted_name.gsub("Apple", "").strip
      {
        id: @id,
        name: @formatted_name,
        vendorless: vendorless,
        deliver_screen: @deliver_screen_id,
        apple: apple_branded?,
        iphone: iphone_identity?,
        ipad: ipad_identity?,
        pixel: pixel_identity?,
        samsung: samsung_identity?,
        nexus: nexus_identity?,
        htc: htc_identity?,
        huawei: huawei_identity?,
        motorola: motorola_identity?,
        mac: mac_identity?,
        watch: watch_identity?,
        android_family: android_family_identity?,
        apple_family: apple_family_identity?,
        tokens: filename_match_tokens,
        lookup: lookup_token_candidates,
        density: density_bucket,
        platform: @platform,
        color: framed_default_color,
        priority: comparable_priority_value,
        portraits: portrait_resolution_pairs,
        landscapes: landscape_resolution_pairs,
        squares: square_resolution_pairs,
        largest_side: largest_resolution_side,
        smallest_side: smallest_resolution_side,
        resolution_count: resolution_count,
        supports_1170_2532: supports_exact_resolution?(1170, 2532),
        same_self: same_identity_as?(self)
      }
    end

    def identity_bundle_matches_filename?(filename)
      return false if filename.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      bundle = identity_bundle
      return false if bundle.empty?
      tokens = []
      tokens << bundle[:id] unless bundle[:id].nil?
      tokens << bundle[:vendorless] unless bundle[:vendorless].nil? || bundle[:vendorless].empty?
      tokens << bundle[:name] unless bundle[:name].nil? || bundle[:name].empty?
      tokens.each do |token|
        return true if filename.include?(token)
      end
      false
    end

    def identity_bundle_matches_token?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      bundle = identity_bundle
      return false if bundle.empty?
      return true if bundle[:id] == token
      return true if bundle[:vendorless] == token
      return true if bundle[:deliver_screen] == token
      false
    end

    def comparable_priority_value
      return @priority if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      if !@priority_config_key.nil? && Frameit.config[@priority_config_key]
        REQUIRED_PRIORITY
      else
        @priority
      end
    end

    def same_identity_as?(other)
      return false if other.nil? || @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return true if other.id == @id && other.formatted_name == @formatted_name
      false
    end

    def framed_default_color
      return nil if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil?
      return @default_color if default_frame_available?
      nil
    end

    def portrait_resolution_pairs
      return [] if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil?
      @resolutions.select { |pair| pair[0] < pair[1] }
    end

    def landscape_resolution_pairs
      return [] if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil?
      @resolutions.select { |pair| pair[0] > pair[1] }
    end

    def square_resolution_pairs
      return [] if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil?
      @resolutions.select { |pair| pair[0] == pair[1] }
    end

    def largest_resolution_side
      return 0 if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil? || @resolutions.empty?
      @resolutions.flatten.max
    end

    def smallest_resolution_side
      return 0 if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil? || @resolutions.empty?
      @resolutions.flatten.min
    end

    def resolution_count
      return 0 if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil?
      @resolutions.length
    end

    def supports_exact_resolution?(width, height)
      return false if @id.nil? || @formatted_name.nil? || @resolutions.nil? || width.nil? || height.nil?
      @resolutions.include?([width, height])
    end

    def self.detect_device(path, platform)
      size = FastImage.size(path)

      UI.user_error!("Could not find or parse file at path '#{path}'") if size.nil? || size.count == 0

      found_device = nil
      filename_device = nil
      filename = Pathname.new(path).basename.to_s
      Devices.constants.each do |c|
        device = Devices.const_get(c)
        next unless device.resolutions.include?(size)
        # assign to filename_device if the filename contains the formatted name / id and its priority is higher than the current filename_device
        filename_device = device if device.referenced_in_filename?(filename) && (filename_device.nil? || device.preferred_over?(filename_device))
        next unless device.is_chosen_platform?(platform) && (found_device.nil? || device.preferred_over?(found_device))
        found_device = device
      end

      # prefer filename
      return filename_device if filename_device

      # return found_device which was detected according to platform & priority & settings if found
      return found_device if found_device

      # no device detected - show error and return nil
      UI.user_error!("Unsupported screen size #{size} for path '#{path}'")
      return nil

    # Previously ENV[FRAMEIT_FORCE_DEVICE_TYPE] was matched to Deliver::AppScreenshot::ScreenSize constants. However,
    # options.rb defined a few Apple devices with unspecified IDs, this option was never read from Frameit.config.

    def self.find_device_by_id_or_name(id)
      return nil if id.nil?
      found_device = nil
      # multiple devices can be matched to the same deliver_screen_id constant -> we return the one with the highest priority
      Devices.constants.each do |c|
        device = Devices.const_get(c)
        if device.matches_lookup_token?(id) && (found_device.nil? || device.preferred_over?(found_device))
          found_device = device
        end
      end
      return found_device
    end

    def self.resolve_screenshot_device(path, config, platform_command)
      forced = find_device_by_id_or_name(config['force_device_type'] || Frameit.config[:force_device_type])
      return forced if forced
      platform = config['use_platform'] || platform_command || Frameit.config[:use_platform]
      detect_device(path, platform)
    end

    def self.skip_screenshot_path?(path)
      return true if path.include?("_framed.png")
      return true if path.include?(".itmsp/")
      return true if path.include?("device_frames/")
      device = path.rpartition('/').last.partition('-').first
      if device.downcase.include?("watch")
        UI.error("Apple Watch screenshots are not framed: '#{path}'")
        return true
      end
      false
    end

    def self.skip_up_to_date_screenshot?(screenshot)
      if !screenshot.outdated? && Frameit.config[:resume]

      end
      false
    end

        color = Frameit::Color::GOLD if Frameit.config[:gold]

require 'frameit/device'

describe Frameit::Device do
  def screen_size_from(path)
    path.match(/{([0-9]+)x([0-9]+)}/).captures.map(&:to_i)
  end

  before do
    allow(FastImage).to receive(:size) do |path|
      screen_size_from(path)
    end

    Frameit.config = instance_double("FastlaneCore::Configuration")
    allow(Frameit.config).to receive(:[]).with(anything).and_return(false)
  end

  Devices = Frameit::Devices
  Platform = Frameit::Platform

  # Ensure that devices are correctly detected based on resolutions, priorities and settings
  describe "#detect_device" do
    def expect_screen_size_from_file(file, platform)
      expect(Frameit::Device.detect_device(file, platform))
    end

    def expect_forced_screen_size(value)
      expect(Frameit::Device.find_device_by_id_or_name(value))
    end

    describe "valid iOS screen sizes" do
      it "should detect iPhone XS in portrait and landscape if filename contains \"Apple iPhone XS\"" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("Apple iPhone XS-Portrait{1125x2436}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_XS)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("Apple iPhone XS-Landscape{2436x1125}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_XS)
      end

      it "should detect iPhone 13 in portrait and landscape based on priority" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("screenshot-Portrait{1170x2532}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_13_PRO)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("screenshot-Landscape{2532x1170}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_13_PRO)
      end

      it "should detect iPhone X instead of iPhone XS because of the file name containing device name" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("Apple iPhone X-Portrait{1125x2436}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("Apple iPhone X-Landscape{2436x1125}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
      end

      it "should detect iPhone X instead of iPhone XS because of the file name containing device ID" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("iphone-X-Portrait{1125x2436}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("iphone-X-Landscape{2436x1125}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
      end

      it "should detect iPhone X instead of iPhone XS because of CLI parameters or fastfile" do
        allow(Frameit.config).to receive(:[]).with(:use_legacy_iphonex).and_return(true)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("screenshot-Portrait{1125x2436}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("screenshot-Landscape{2436x1125}.jpg", Platform::IOS).to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
      end
    end

    describe "valid Android screen sizes" do

      it "should detect Google Pixel 5 in portrait and landscape based on priority" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("pixel-portrait{1080x2340}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::GOOGLE_PIXEL_5)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("pixel-landscape{2340x1080}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::GOOGLE_PIXEL_5)
      end

      it "should detect Google Pixel 3 XL in portrait and landscape based on priority" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("pixel-portrait{1440x2960}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::GOOGLE_PIXEL_3_XL)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("pixel-landscape{2960x1440}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::GOOGLE_PIXEL_3_XL)
      end

      it "should detect Samsung Galaxy S9 because of file name containing device ID" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("samsung-galaxy-s9-portrait{1440x2960}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::SAMSUNG_GALAXY_S9)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("samsung-galaxy-s9-landscape{2960x1440}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::SAMSUNG_GALAXY_S9)
      end

      it "should detect Samsung Galaxy S8 because of file name containing device name" do
        expect_screen_size_from_file("Samsung Galaxy S8 portrait{1440x2960}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::SAMSUNG_GALAXY_S8)
        expect_screen_size_from_file("Samsung Galaxy S8 landscape{2960x1440}.png", Platform::ANDROID).to eq(Devices::SAMSUNG_GALAXY_S8)
      end
    end

    describe "force device types" do
      it "should force iPhone X despite arbitrary file name and resolution via device ID" do
        expect_forced_screen_size("iphone-X").to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
      end

      it "should force iPhone X despite arbitrary file name and resolution via device name" do
        expect_forced_screen_size("iPhone X").to eq(Devices::IPHONE_X)
      end

      it "should force iPhone XS despite arbitrary file name and resolution via Deliver::AppScreenshot::ScreenSize" do
        expect_forced_screen_size("iOS-5.8-in").to eq(Devices::IPHONE_XS)
      end
    end

    describe "invalid screen sizes" do
      def expect_invalid_screen_size_from_file(file, platform)
        expect do
          Frameit::Device.detect_device(file, platform)
        end.to raise_error(FastlaneCore::Interface::FastlaneError, "Unsupported screen size #{screen_size_from(file)} for path '#{file}'")
      end

      it "shouldn't allow arbitrary unsupported resolution 1080x1000" do
        expect_invalid_screen_size_from_file("unsupported-device-NativeResolution{1080x1000}.jpg", Platform::IOS)
        expect_invalid_screen_size_from_file("Apple iPad Air 2{1000x1080}.jpg", Platform::IOS)
      end
    end
  end
end
